description_en: Updates the resource group for resource ownership
description_zh: 该接口用于修改资源归属资源组
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public change-resource-manager-resource-group --resource-type project --resource-id test_project --resource-manager-resource-group-id 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4p****' --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceManagerResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:
project: workspace. Select this value if you want to update the resource group to which a DataWorks edition belongs.
tenantresourcegroup: exclusive resource group. Select this value if you want to update the resource group to which a DataWorks exclusive resource group belongs
parameters.help_zh:
资源的类型，取值如下：
project，工作空间。如果您需要修改的是DataWorks版本所归属的资源组信息时，请选择project。
tenantresourcegroup，独享资源组。如果您需要修改的是DataWorks独享资源组所归属的资源组信息时，请选择tenantresourcegroup
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource. Valid values:
If ResourceType is set to project, ResourceId is the name of the workspace (ProjectIdentifier) obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780068.html operation.
If ResourceType is set to tenantresourcegroup, ResourceId is the identifier of the exclusive resource group obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780075.html operation. This applies only to resource groups whose ResourceGroupType is 7, 8, or 9
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型的ID标识符，取值如下：
当ResourceType=project时，则ResourceId可以理解为通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780068.html接口获取工作空间的名称（ProjectIdentifier）。
当ResourceType=tenantresourcegroup时，则ResourceId可以理解为通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780075.html接口获取独享资源组的标识（Identifier）, 仅限ResourceGroupType=7、8、9的类型
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the resource group was updated

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
